# Vendored: `cache_service.py`

`cache_service.py` is `python/detpy/cache_service.py` from `Mircoguidetti/fenvix-engine-cli` at commit
`a20b93d7f840b23f71c73c03efdaee3d6a233252` (branch `claude/shared-cache`), byte for byte (standard library only).
SHA-256 `2b93cd9aac59ba160bc28ae0e9c4b725b0abd29ec6784e5ed910f479eeea33a8` (checked by `test/cache.test.ts`). To update:
copy the file from the new commit, change the commit and the SHA-256 here and in the test, and bump `engineCliCommit`
in `cdk.json` to the same commit (the runners' client and this service go together).
